## Problem and resulting behavior

PowerShell's shared validation and review setup lack the fixes accepted in [TerraformStyleGuide #68](https://github.com/franklesniak/TerraformStyleGuide/pull/68). This ten-file carryback brings those fixes into PowerShell while preserving its package identities, P1 fixture, guide names and blank-line checks.

Markdown checks still run a fresh native parser on every call. The checker can reuse at most eight bounded structural snapshots when the complete input and helper identities match. Results remain deep copies. Fresh structural conversion uses the source-checked compiled helper with the existing strict byte, depth, duplicate-name, type and schema checks. Reserved PowerShell member names retain the whole-document conversion path; generic JSON callers keep their existing behavior.

The validator also skips six element-filter pipelines when parser code/link arrays are empty. Array-type checks and all nonempty filters remain in place. The permanent SelfTest adds 109 parser/context cases, including 30 literal-null refusals. Fresh parsing, conversion/reuse boundaries and error behavior remain unchanged.

The SelfTest corrects metadata date-target selection and literal-path private clock handling, including date changes and cleanup failures. Artifact parsing declares its actual byte-array output. CI proof fixtures resolve Git through required PowerShell 7 and preserve native failure results.

The dedicated Copilot workflow retains verified acquisition, runtime admission, locked installation, hooks and the final immutable-input guard. It omits the aggregate validation step; ordinary coding setup and CI retain full validation. The instruction validator checks the optional dedicated workflow in current, staged and revision inputs. The behavior job uses a 59-minute job limit and a 45-minute test-step limit.

The workflow dependency lock selects KaTeX 0.18.2 through an exact-parent override under `micromark-extension-math@3.1.0`. The maintenance note records the parent's range exception, required caller compatibility and removal condition.

## Validation

- One locked installation and both installed dependency graphs passed.
- The unchanged Node checks retain their verified 600-assertion result, with zero failures, cancellations, skips or todos. A fresh Linux full-suite run on the final candidate passed all 11 normal hooks, including the complete instruction mutation SelfTest and its added 109 cases.
- Windows PowerShell 7.6.5: parser and PSScriptAnalyzer checks on all three changed PowerShell files reported no findings. Artifact output controls, strict conversion and reuse, actual setup-reader controls, four CI helper tests, patched dependency callers and PowerShell blank-line semantics passed.
- The two final PowerShell files passed all 109 cases and parser/PSScriptAnalyzer checks on Windows PowerShell 7.6.5 and Linux PowerShell 7.6.3. All five actual accepted-base/committed-head modes passed for the final commit, including the genuine October 7 UTC metadata finalization check. Proposed-policy results remain diagnostics and do not replace accepted-policy authority.
- The ordinary current audit checked both installed dependency roots and returned CLEAN with no findings, accepted packages or unused exceptions. Native main matched the audit authority before and after the audit.
- Normal commit hooks passed. Source, dependency and Git input guards remained unchanged during validation; all owned command jobs and containers ended empty or absent. The final Windows endpoint continuation used a short private temporary folder and removed it after successful cleanup.

The predeclared complete-suite comparison measured 542.561 seconds for the final candidate and 574.041 seconds for the original validator/test pair on the same dataset: 31.480 seconds (5.484%) saved, including the added test cost. The margin above the selected 5% threshold is only 2.778 seconds. One pair provides no variance estimate; candidate-only preflight and shared runtime/cache history leave uncontrolled effects. This supports scoped retention, not a stable speed guarantee or a cure for hosted review cancellations. No resampling occurred. [D94.1 options, rubric and selection](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/61e4d95832fafca1df829cfe9aa3e36ec75d39a4/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A06/PS-TF68-carryback/current-author-diagnostic/interpretation/REPORT.md).

Local validation combines explicitly verified results from multiple runs. Earlier runners stopped on cleanup policy, cache placement or result-reader faults. Their failed records remain preserved. Completed assertions were reused, and only missing groups were run. The Node-only result judgment requires the direct 600-test success plus exact owned terminal collection and unchanged inputs; 54 positive and negative controls passed. The causes of three historical adopted-child statuses remain unknown. Other stages retain the strict zero-exit cleanup rule. The first final-commit endpoint run also stopped when the runner's deep temporary path exceeded Git's Windows path handling. That failure is preserved. A short-path continuation ran only the four unfinished PowerShell modes and the audit; the exact-head maintenance-classifier pass was reused.

## Review disposition

Copilot R1 claimed that absent optional input paths make the final Git guard fail. The exact committed guard passed three clean legacy/modern layout fixtures with optional paths absent and rejected eleven mutation cases, including six staged, untracked or ignored creations. Missing names are path filters, not required filesystem inputs. Narrowing the list would lose creation detection. The finding-specific evaluation selected retaining the existing guard (97.8/100); no product change is needed. The controls used Git 2.55.0 and Bash 5.2.21 and cover the guard, not full historical installation or dedicated-service activation. [Options, scoring, evidence and Git references](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/301e139d0170a323b88e2bdadfc750fa5ea6cd06/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A06/PS-TF68-carryback/PR235-round1-R1/REPORT.md).

Copilot R2 correctly identifies repeated decoder hashing and reflection, but their isolated cost is unmeasured. The selected no-change disposition (92.7/100) retains current per-definition identity, failed-initialization and generic-caller behavior; it makes no negligible-overhead claim. [R2 options, scores and evidence](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/33b95c196e5e9176c08572509997d21adf9904c0/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A06/PS-TF68-carryback/round1-recovery-findings/R2-converter-metadata-cache.md).

Copilot R3 identifies four repeated npm sanitation blocks. All four are currently identical and protect six calls across separate processes; exporting two settings does not remove other inherited npm configuration names. The selected no-change disposition (96.1/100) retains per-process filtering and existing independent hostile-input and producer-failure controls. [R3 options, scores and evidence](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/33b95c196e5e9176c08572509997d21adf9904c0/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A06/PS-TF68-carryback/round1-recovery-findings/R3-npm-environment-duplication.md).

On the earlier commit 504cd76, ordinary source validation passed. Dynamic runs 37524396256 and 37538942393 were cancelled at their 20-minute job limits. In the recovery run, all eleven hooks and the final guard passed, then review processing was cancelled. These cancellations remain recorded; they do not establish success for the new commit. Both completed Copilot reviews report Lite; their findings have documented dispositions and resolved threads, which do not convert cancelled CI into success. The separate manual Codex review reported no major issues on that earlier commit. Both reviewers must review the new commit before acceptance.

The three-channel recovery allowance is exhausted. [The selected recovery proposal](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/33b95c196e5e9176c08572509997d21adf9904c0/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A06/PS-TF68-carryback/round1-recovery-exhaustion/REPORT.md) preserves the CI hold, prepares an unsent provider inquiry and a bounded current-source diagnostic. The old-input recovery allowance remains exhausted. The subsequent D94.1 decision selected and validated the bounded source change described above; a new-head review does not erase that history, reset the PR clock or permit a failed-CI merge. Dedicated setup selection is still unproved.

## Remaining acceptance

The shared carryback derives from accepted Terraform PR68. This PR also adds the empty-array optimization and its permanent tests; those common changes require comparison and an applicable Terraform follow-up after acceptance. The reverse comparison must use the actual landed commits. Both current remote reviews and all current CI must pass before normal merge; no failed or cancelled CI exception applies.

A legitimate Copilot service run must separately prove that it selects the dedicated setup, retains the final guard and completes successfully. An ordinary workflow run alone does not prove service activation. That proof and the final reverse comparison remain required for paired acceptance.

@@ -0,0 +1,887 @@
+name: Copilot code review preparation
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - "**"
+    paths:
+      - .github/workflows/**
+      - .husky/**
+      - requirements-dev.txt
+      - "**/*.yml"
+      - "**/*.yaml"
+      - .npmrc
+      - npm-shrinkwrap.json
+      - package.json
+      - package-lock.json
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - .github/workflows/**
+      - .husky/**
+      - requirements-dev.txt
+      - "**/*.yml"
+      - "**/*.yaml"
+      - .npmrc
+      - npm-shrinkwrap.json
+      - package.json
+      - package-lock.json
+
+# Review setup prepares tools and hooks. Complete validation remains in
+# ordinary CI and the coding-agent setup; readiness is not acceptance.
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  copilot-setup-steps:
+    name: Prepare locked code review tools and hooks
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 59
+    permissions: {}
+    steps:
+      - name: Acquire triggering revision without an action
+        timeout-minutes: 5
+        id: acquire
+        shell: pwsh
+        env:
+          GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
+          GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
+          GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+
+          # Do not load user/system Git credentials or hooks during anonymous acquisition.
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: external Git command configuration is not allowed'
+          }
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM = '1'
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = '/dev/null'
+          $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT = '0'
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GITHUB_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GH_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: a token was projected into a code job'
+          }
+          # git reports absent state with a non-zero status in places this step
+          # accepts, so native-command error mapping is disabled the same way
+          # the other governed steps disable it and each status is classified
+          # explicitly instead.
+          if (Test-Path Variable:PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference) {
+              $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
+          }
+
+          # Every value below is set by the runner before any repository code
+          # executes, and is read from the environment rather than expanded as
+          # a workflow expression, because no governed script step in this
+          # repository contains an expression at all.
+          $strServerUrl = $env:GITHUB_SERVER_URL
+          $strRepository = $env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY
+          $strSha = $env:GITHUB_SHA
+          if ($strServerUrl -cne 'https://github.com') {
+              throw 'acquire: the runner named an unexpected server'
+          }
+          if ($strRepository -cne 'franklesniak/PSStyleGuide') {
+              throw 'acquire: the triggering repository is not the expected repository'
+          }
+          # A full 40-hex commit is required rather than a ref. A ref would let
+          # the fetch resolve to whatever the ref points at when the fetch runs,
+          # which for a push to a busy branch is not necessarily the revision
+          # that triggered this run.
+          if ($strSha -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') {
+              throw 'acquire: the triggering revision is not a full commit hash'
+          }
+
+          # The workspace is proven empty rather than cleaned. Cleaning would
+          # decide what to delete from state that is already present, while an
+          # emptiness assertion has no such input.
+          if (@([System.IO.Directory]::EnumerateFileSystemEntries($PWD.Path)).Count -ne 0) {
+              throw 'acquire: the workspace is not empty'
+          }
+
+          # Resolved from a fixed candidate list rather than by name. Nothing has
+          # executed in this step yet, so name resolution is not attacker-
+          # influenced here -- but PowerShell aliases curl and wget to
+          # Invoke-WebRequest on the Desktop edition, this repository already
+          # pins the Git executable this way in the verify step, and relying on
+          # an alias being absent is a property of the host rather than
+          # something this file asserts. Constant, so nothing later can rebind
+          # it.
+          $strResolvedGit = @('/usr/bin/git', '/bin/git') | Where-Object { [System.IO.File]::Exists($_) } | Select-Object -First 1
+          if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($strResolvedGit)) { throw 'acquire: Git was not resolved as an application' }
+          New-Variable -Name strGitPath -Value $strResolvedGit -Option Constant
+
+          & $strGitPath -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null init --quiet .
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: git init exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
+          & $strGitPath remote add origin "$strServerUrl/$strRepository"
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: git remote add exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
+          # Fetching the commit itself, not a ref that names it. No credential
+          # is supplied and none is configured, so nothing is persisted for the
+          # next step to have to clean up.
+          for ($intAttempt = 1; $intAttempt -le 3; $intAttempt++) {
+              & $strGitPath -c credential.helper= -c http.extraheader= -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null fetch --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules origin $strSha
+              $intFetchExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
+              if ($intFetchExitCode -eq 0) { break }
+              if ($intAttempt -lt 3) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }
+          }
+          if ($intFetchExitCode -ne 0) { throw "acquire: git fetch exited $intFetchExitCode after three attempts" }
+          & $strGitPath -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout --quiet --detach FETCH_HEAD
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: git checkout exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
+          $arrHeadOutput = @(& $strGitPath rev-parse HEAD)
+          $intHeadExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
+          if ($intHeadExitCode -ne 0) {
+              throw "acquire: git rev-parse exited $intHeadExitCode"
+          }
+          if ($arrHeadOutput.Count -ne 1) {
+              throw 'acquire: git rev-parse must return exactly one line'
+          }
+          $strHead = $arrHeadOutput[0].Trim()
+          if ($strHead -cne $strSha) {
+              throw 'acquire: the checked out revision is not the triggering revision'
+          }
+          Write-Information "acquire: anonymous exact checkout of $strSha" -InformationAction Continue
+      - name: Verify checkout credential cleanup
+        timeout-minutes: 2
+        id: verify-checkout-credentials
+        shell: pwsh
+        env:
+          GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
+          GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
+          GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+
+          # Do not load user/system Git credentials or hooks during anonymous acquisition.
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: external Git command configuration is not allowed'
+          }
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM = '1'
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = '/dev/null'
+          $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT = '0'
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GITHUB_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GH_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: a token was projected into a code job'
+          }
+          # git config exits 1 when a queried key is absent, which is the secure
+          # expected state this step asserts. If the runner enables native-command
+          # error mapping, that accepted status would terminate the step before the
+          # explicit capture below runs, so it is disabled the same way
+          # markdownlint.yml disables it.
+          if (Test-Path Variable:PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference) {
+              $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
+          }
+          # Resolved here too. Constants do not cross step boundaries, and this
+          # step asserts a credential property, so the executable it asks must
+          # not be chosen by name resolution either.
+          $strResolvedGit = @('/usr/bin/git', '/bin/git') | Where-Object { [System.IO.File]::Exists($_) } | Select-Object -First 1
+          if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($strResolvedGit)) { throw 'credential-policy: Git was not resolved as an application' }
+          New-Variable -Name strGitPath -Value $strResolvedGit -Option Constant
+          $arrRemoteUrls = @(& $strGitPath remote get-url --all origin)
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrRemoteUrls.Count -ne 1) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: unable to resolve exactly one origin URL'
+          }
+          if ($arrRemoteUrls[0] -cne 'https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide') {
+              throw 'credential-policy: origin is not a credential-free GitHub HTTPS URL'
+          }
+          $arrHelpers = @(& $strGitPath config --local --get-all credential.helper)
+          $intHelperExit = $LASTEXITCODE
+          $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
+          if (($intHelperExit -ne 0 -and $intHelperExit -ne 1) -or $arrHelpers.Count -ne 0) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: a local credential helper is configured'
+          }
+          $arrAuthorizationKeys = @(& $strGitPath config --local --name-only --get-regexp '^http\..*\.extraheader$')
+          $intAuthorizationExit = $LASTEXITCODE
+          $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
+          if (($intAuthorizationExit -ne 0 -and $intAuthorizationExit -ne 1) -or $arrAuthorizationKeys.Count -ne 0) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: persisted HTTP authorization is configured'
+          }
+
+          $arrEffectiveConfig = @(& $strGitPath config --show-scope --name-only --list)
+          $intEffectiveConfigExit = $LASTEXITCODE
+          if ($intEffectiveConfigExit -ne 0 -or @($arrEffectiveConfig | Where-Object { $_ -cmatch '^(system|global)\s' }).Count -ne 0) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: external Git configuration was not excluded'
+          }
+
+      - name: Acquire published main reference
+        timeout-minutes: 5
+        shell: pwsh
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+
+          # Do not load user/system Git credentials or hooks during anonymous acquisition.
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: external Git command configuration is not allowed'
+          }
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM = '1'
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = '/dev/null'
+          $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT = '0'
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GITHUB_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GH_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: a token was projected into a code job'
+          }
+          # git reports absent state with a non-zero status in places this step
+          # accepts, so native-command error mapping is disabled the same way
+          # the other governed steps disable it and each status is classified
+          # explicitly instead.
+          if (Test-Path Variable:PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference) {
+              $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
+          }
+
+          $strGitPath = @('/usr/bin/git', '/bin/git') | Where-Object {
+              [IO.File]::Exists($_)
+          } | Select-Object -First 1
+          if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($strGitPath)) {
+              throw 'main: fixed Git is unavailable'
+          }
+          $arrUrls = @(& $strGitPath remote get-url --all origin)
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrUrls.Count -ne 1 -or
+              $arrUrls[0] -cne 'https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide') {
+              throw 'main: origin identity is invalid'
+          }
+          for ($intAttempt = 1; $intAttempt -le 3; $intAttempt++) {
+              & $strGitPath -c credential.helper= -c http.extraheader= -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null fetch --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules origin refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main
+              $intFetchExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
+              if ($intFetchExitCode -eq 0) {
+                  break
+              }
+              if ($intAttempt -lt 3) {
+                  Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
+              }
+          }
+          if ($intFetchExitCode -ne 0) {
+              throw "main: git fetch exited $intFetchExitCode after three attempts"
+          }
+          $arrMain = @(& $strGitPath rev-parse --verify refs/remotes/origin/main)
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrMain.Count -ne 1 -or
+              $arrMain[0] -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' -or $arrMain[0] -ceq ('0' * 40)) {
+              throw 'main: expected one nonzero commit identity'
+          }
+          $strMain = $arrMain[0]
+          $arrType = @(& $strGitPath cat-file -t $strMain)
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrType.Count -ne 1 -or $arrType[0] -cne 'commit') {
+              throw 'main: fetched authority is not a commit'
+          }
+          $arrHead = @(& $strGitPath rev-parse HEAD)
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrHead.Count -ne 1 -or $arrHead[0] -cne $env:GITHUB_SHA) {
+              throw 'main: event checkout changed during authority acquisition'
+          }
+          Write-Information "main: setup-time authority $strMain; event checkout $env:GITHUB_SHA" -InformationAction Continue
+
+      - name: Reject alternate npm install inputs
+        timeout-minutes: 2
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
+          GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
+          GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [[ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ||
+            -n "${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GIT_CONFIG_COUNT:-}" ||
+            -n "${GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS:-}" ]]; then
+            echo '::error::Unexpected credential or Git configuration channel.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
+          declare -ar alternate_inputs=(
+            .npmrc
+            npm-shrinkwrap.json
+            .github/workflows/.npmrc
+            .github/workflows/npm-shrinkwrap.json
+          )
+          for alternate_input in "${alternate_inputs[@]}"; do
+            if [[ -e "${alternate_input}" || -L "${alternate_input}" ]]; then
+              echo "::error file=${alternate_input}::Unsupported npm" \
+                'install input.'
+              exit 1
+            fi
+          done
+
+      - name: Detect locked validation-tool layout
+        timeout-minutes: 2
+        id: toolchain
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
+          GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
+          GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [[ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ||
+            -n "${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GIT_CONFIG_COUNT:-}" ||
+            -n "${GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS:-}" ]]; then
+            echo '::error::Unexpected credential or Git configuration channel.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
+          workflow_manifest='.github/workflows/package.json'
+          workflow_lock='.github/workflows/package-lock.json'
+
+          for required_file in "${workflow_manifest}" "${workflow_lock}"; do
+            if [[ ! -f "${required_file}" || -L "${required_file}" ]]; then
+              echo "::error file=${required_file}::Required locked npm input" \
+                'is missing or is not a regular file.'
+              exit 1
+            fi
+          done
+
+          classify_npm_input() {
+            if [[ -L "$1" ]]; then
+              printf 'symlink'
+            elif [[ -f "$1" ]]; then
+              printf 'regular-file'
+            elif [[ -e "$1" ]]; then
+              printf 'non-regular'
+            else
+              printf 'absent'
+            fi
+          }
+
+          root_manifest_state="$(classify_npm_input package.json)"
+          root_lock_state="$(classify_npm_input package-lock.json)"
+
+          if [[ "${root_manifest_state}" == regular-file && \
+            "${root_lock_state}" == regular-file ]]; then
+            echo 'layout=modern' >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
+          elif [[ "${root_manifest_state}" == absent && \
+            "${root_lock_state}" == absent ]]; then

+          if [[ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ||
+            -n "${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GIT_CONFIG_COUNT:-}" ||
+            -n "${GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS:-}" ]]; then
+            echo '::error::Unexpected credential or Git configuration channel.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
+          # env includes inherited names that are not valid Bash identifiers.
+          npm_environment=(/usr/bin/env)
+          while IFS= read -r -d '' entry; do
+            variable=${entry%%=*}
+            if [[ "${variable,,}" == npm_config_* ]]; then
+              npm_environment+=(-u "${variable}")
+            fi
+          done < <(/usr/bin/env -0)
+          # Wait for this process substitution before running any other child.
+          if ! wait "$!"; then
+            echo '::error::Unable to read the package-manager environment.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          export npm_config_userconfig=/dev/null
+          export npm_config_globalconfig=/etc/npmrc-absent-by-policy
+          npm_environment+=(-- "npm_config_userconfig=${npm_config_userconfig}"
+            "npm_config_globalconfig=${npm_config_globalconfig}")
+          if [[ ! -c "${npm_config_userconfig}" || -s "${npm_config_userconfig}" ||
+            -e "${npm_config_globalconfig}" || -L "${npm_config_globalconfig}" ]]; then
+            echo '::error::Unexpected package-manager configuration source.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          "${npm_environment[@]}" npm --prefix .github/workflows run prepare
+          test "$(git config --get core.hooksPath)" = '.husky/_'
+          test -f .husky/_/pre-commit && test -x .husky/_/pre-commit
+
+      - name: Verify final immutable setup inputs
+        if: always() && steps.toolchain.outcome == 'success'
+        timeout-minutes: 2
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [[ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ||
+            -n "${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GIT_CONFIG_COUNT:-}" ||
+            -n "${GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS:-}" ]]; then
+            echo '::error::Unexpected credential or Git configuration channel.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
+          declare -ar setup_inputs=(
+            package.json package-lock.json .github/workflows/package.json .github/workflows/package-lock.json
+            .github/workflows/ci-toolchain.json requirements-dev.txt .github/workflows/Invoke-LockedPythonHook.ps1
+            .pre-commit-config.yaml .github/workflows/install-husky.mjs .husky/pre-commit
+            .github/workflows/lint-staged-markdown.mjs
+          )
+          git diff --cached --exit-code HEAD -- "${setup_inputs[@]}"
+          git diff --exit-code HEAD -- "${setup_inputs[@]}"
+          untracked_inputs="$(git ls-files --others -- "${setup_inputs[@]}")"
+          if [[ -n "${untracked_inputs}" ]]; then
+            printf '::error::Untracked setup inputs changed: %s\n' "${untracked_inputs}"
+            exit 1
+          fi
